$comment: Single source of truth for the development account roster.
Consumed by scripts/seed-supabase.mjs (Node, via fs), by the Admin login
page, and by the mobile sign-in screen, so the roster and password can
never drift between the seeder and what the apps display.
DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Emails use the reserved, non-deliverable .invalid TLD.
A seeded project must never be a production project: these credentials are
deliberately well-known so the team can sign in without coordination.

accounts.purpose: Sees everything and satisfies every capability gate, including Categories, Audit log and Settings.
Trust and safety: verification, Tasker applications, users, tasks, bookings, reports, support tickets.
Money and disputes: payments and ledger, reconciliation, withdrawals, disputes.
Identity approved. Owns the seeded open tasks. Post, edit and publish tasks, browse, select an offer.

profile.bio: Homeowner in Quezon City. I post household tasks — cleaning, minor repairs, and errands — and prefer verified Taskers who arrive on time and communicate clearly.

accounts.purpose: Approved and unsuspended. Submit and withdraw offers, Tasker Dashboard, edit the public Tasker profile.

profile.bio: Multi-skilled Tasker serving Metro Manila. Aircon servicing, plumbing, and flat-pack furniture assembly, with my own tools. Verified identity and consistently on schedule.

accounts.purpose: Application in review. Populates the Admin approvals queue. Cannot submit offers yet, which is correct.

profile.bio: Applying to become a Tasker. Background in deep cleaning and organizing for condos and small offices around Quezon City.
